items.title: Awesome Bitcoin
items.content_text:
### Playgrounds

*   [Raw transaction decoder](https://808bits.com/tools/raw-transaction-decoder/) - Paste a raw Bitcoin transaction (legacy, SegWit or Taproot) and see every byte named: scripts disassembled, addresses derived, witness and sequence fields explained. Runs in the browser, no server.

### Read

*   [Bitcoin Book of BIPs](https://adamdecaf.github.io/bitcoin-bips-book/) - Deployed and complete [BIPs (⭐11k)](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips), grouped by theme. PDF, ePUB, and web.

items.title: Awesome Web Security
items.content_text:
### CSRF - Cross-Site Request Forgery

*   [PayloadsAllTheThings - CSRF Injection (⭐81k)](https://github.com/swisskyrepo/PayloadsAllTheThings/tree/master/Cross-Site%20Request%20Forgery) - Written by [@swisskyrepo](https://github.com/swisskyrepo).

### AngularJS

*   [DOM based Angular sandbox escapes](https://portswigger.net/research/dom-based-angularjs-sandbox-escapes) - Written by [@garethheyes](https://twitter.com/garethheyes).
*   [XSS without HTML: Client-Side Template Injection with AngularJS](https://portswigger.net/research/xss-without-html-client-side-template-injection-with-angularjs) - Written by [Gareth Heyes](https://www.blogger.com/profile/10856178524811553475).

### Crypto

*   [What is a Side-Channel Attack ?](https://www.csoonline.com/article/567149/what-is-a-side-channel-attack-how-these-end-runs-around-encryption-put-everyone-at-risk.html) - Written by [J.M Porup](https://www.csoonline.com/author/J.M.-Porup/).

### JWT

*   [Hardcoded secrets, unverified tokens, and other common JWT mistakes](https://semgrep.dev/blog/2020/hardcoded-secrets-unverified-tokens-and-other-common-jwt-mistakes/) - Written by [@ermil0v](https://twitter.com/ermil0v).

### CSP

*   [GitHub's CSP journey](https://github.blog/2016-04-12-githubs-csp-journey/) - Written by [@ptoomey3](https://github.com/ptoomey3).
*   [GitHub's post-CSP journey](https://github.blog/2017-01-19-githubs-post-csp-journey/) - Written by [@ptoomey3](https://github.com/ptoomey3).

### Remote Code Execution

*   [How I Chained 4 vulnerabilities on GitHub Enterprise, From SSRF Execution Chain to RCE!](https://blog.orange.tw/posts/2017-07-how-i-chained-4-vulnerabilities-on/) - Written by [Orange](https://blog.orange.tw/).

### SQL Injection

*   [GitHub Enterprise SQL Injection](https://blog.orange.tw/posts/2017-01-bug-bounty-github-enterprise-sql-injection/) - Written by [Orange](https://blog.orange.tw/).

### XXE

*   [Automating local DTD discovery for XXE exploitation](https://gosecure.ai/blog/2019/07/16/automating-local-dtd-discovery-for-xxe-exploitation) - Written by [Philippe Arteau](https://twitter.com/h3xstream).

### Frontend (like SOP bypass, URL spoofing, and something like that)

*   [JSON hijacking for the modern web](https://portswigger.net/research/json-hijacking-for-the-modern-web) - Written by [portswigger](https://portswigger.net/).

### Reconnaissance / OSINT - Open-Source Intelligence

*   [SpiderFoot (⭐22k)](https://github.com/smicallef/spiderfoot) - Open source footprinting and intelligence-gathering tool by [@binarypool](https://twitter.com/binarypool).

### Application / Server-Side Request Forgery

*   [Where the LLM Stops: Deterministic Scoring in an AI-Assisted VAPT Pipeline](https://aayushyadav.hashnode.dev/where-the-llm-stops-deterministic-scoring-in-an-ai-assisted-vapt-pipeline) - Technical write-up on designing an AI-assisted VAPT pipeline with deterministic CVSS scoring, passive confidence verification, and LLM-generated vulnerability explanations and remediation.
*   [The 200 That Proved Nothing](https://aivist.dev/the-200-that-proved-nothing) - Why a 200 OK is not proof of an access-control bug: a seeded BOLA benchmark where a model asked to confirm a secure endpoint 79 times and a downgrade-only code gate refused every one, plus the similarity thresholds, a deterministic check that failed the same way, and a plausible fix measured and rejected for making results worse.

### Miscellaneous / Server-Side Request Forgery

*   [A glimpse into GitHub's Bug Bounty workflow](https://github.blog/2017-02-22-githubs-bug-bounty-workflow/) - Written by [@gregose](https://github.com/gregose).
*   [How we abused Slack's TURN servers to gain access to internal services](https://www.enablesecurity.com/blog/slack-webrtc-turn-compromise-and-bug-bounty/) - Written by [@sandrogauci](https://twitter.com/sandrogauci).
*   [DOS File Path Magic Tricks](https://medium.com/walmartglobaltech/dos-file-path-magic-tricks-5eda7a7a85fa) - Written by [@clr2of8](https://medium.com/@clr2of8).

items.title: Awesome Homematic
items.content_text:
### Community Ressources (mostly german language)

*   [Homematic Forum: Addons & Tools Übersicht](https://homematic-forum.de/forum/viewtopic.php?t=46890) - Übersicht über Addons und Tools für CCU / OpenCCU.

### Documentation

*   [ccu-addon-howto (⭐12)](https://github.com/homematic-community/ccu-addon-howto) - Howto für die Entwicklung von Addons für die Homematic CCU und OpenCCU.
*   [HomeMatic-Script Dokumentation](https://www.eq-3.de/downloads/download/homematic/hm_web_ui_doku/HM-Skript_Teil_1_Sprachbeschreibung_V2.3.pdf) - Offizielle Dokumentation von eQ-3: [Teil 1 Sprachbeschreibung](https://www.eq-3.de/downloads/download/homematic/hm_web_ui_doku/HM-Skript_Teil_1_Sprachbeschreibung_V2.3.pdf), [Teil 2 Objektmodell](https://www.eq-3.de/Downloads/eq3/download%20bereich/hm_web_ui_doku/HM_Script_Teil_2_Objektmodell_V1.2.pdf), [Teil 3 Beispiele](https://www.eq-3.de/Downloads/eq3/download%20bereich/hm_web_ui_doku/HM_Script_Teil_3_Beispiele_V1.1.pdf), [Teil 4 Datenpunkte](https://www.eq-3.de/Downloads/eq3/download%20bereich/hm_web_ui_doku/HM-Script_4-Datenpunkte.pdf).
*   [HomeMatic XML-RPC API](https://www.eq-3.de/Downloads/eq3/download%20bereich/hm_web_ui_doku/HM_XmlRpc_API.pdf) - Offizielle Spezifikation der XML-RPC Schnittstelle der Interface-Prozesse von eQ-3.
*   [OpenCCU Wiki (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/OpenCCU/OpenCCU/wiki) - Installation, Administration und Nutzung von OpenCCU.

### CCU Alternatives

*   [OCCU (⭐213)](https://github.com/eq-3/occu) - The HM-OCCU-SDK published by eQ-3, the base of debmatic, piVCCU and OpenCCU.
*   [OpenCCU (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/OpenCCU/OpenCCU) - Lightweight, OCCU and Linux/buildroot-based distribution for running a HomeMatic CCU on embedded devices like the RaspberryPi, x86/ARM or as virtual appliance (formerly known as RaspberryMatic).

### Alternative Sensors, Actuators and Hardware Modifications

*   [AskSin++](https://asksinpp.de/) - Dokumentation, Sketche und Community-Projekte rund um Selbstbau-Komponenten für HomeMatic auf Basis von Arduino/STM32 und CC1101.
*   [HB-RF-ETH (⭐58)](https://github.com/alexreinert/HB-RF-ETH) - Platine und Firmware um ein Homematic Funkmodul (HM-MOD-RPI-PCB, RPI-RF-MOD) per Netzwerk an debmatic oder piVCCU anzubinden.
*   [HB-RF-ETH-ng (⭐14)](https://github.com/Xerolux/HB-RF-ETH-ng) - Modernisierte Next-Generation-Firmware für die HB-RF-ETH Platine mit neuer Weboberfläche und MQTT-Monitoring.
*   [HB-UNI-Sen-WEA (⭐69)](https://github.com/jp112sdl/HB-UNI-Sen-WEA) - Selbstbau-Wetterstation für HomeMatic.

### CCU Addons

*   [ccu-addon-mui (⭐6)](https://github.com/firsttris/ccu-addon-mui) - Moderne, responsive Progressive Web App (PWA) für die CCU3 mit integriertem WebSocket-Server.
*   [CUxD (⭐67)](https://github.com/jens-maus/cuxd) - Der "Leatherman" für die CCU. Verbindet FS20, ... (💵 EnOcean, ...), stellt virtuelle Geräte und hilfreiche Tools zur Verfügung.
*   [CUxD-Highcharts (⭐16)](https://github.com/homematic-community/CUxD-Highcharts) - Visualisiert CUxD DEVLOGS mit Highcharts/Highstock (verwaist, Maintainer gesucht).
*   [Email (⭐47)](https://github.com/homematic-community/hm_email) - HomeMatic CCU Addon für den Email Versand.
*   [hm-influxdb2 (⭐1)](https://github.com/cthil/hm-influxdb2) - Addon for the CCU3/OpenCCU to log data from devices into an InfluxDB2.
*   [hm-print (⭐12)](https://github.com/homematic-community/hm-print) - CCU Programme drucken.
*   [hm-sonos (⭐17)](https://github.com/homematic-community/hm-sonos) - HomeMatic CCU Addon zur Steuerung von Sonos Playern.
*   [hm\_pdetect (⭐73)](https://github.com/homematic-community/hm_pdetect) - Anwesenheitserkennung über die FRITZ!-Box
*   [homematic-node-exporter (⭐2)](https://github.com/jaroschek/homematic-node-exporter) - Prometheus Node Exporter packaged as Addon for the Homematic CCU3 and OpenCCU.
*   [HQ-WebUI (⭐50)](https://github.com/homematic-community/hq-webui) - Schnelles alternatives WebUI für die Homematic CCU mit Skript-Editor (verwaist, Maintainer gesucht).
*   [JP-HB-Devices-addon (⭐57)](https://github.com/jp112sdl/JP-HB-Devices-addon) - Addon das über 80 Selbstbau-Geräte (AskSinPP HomeBrew) in die CCU/OpenCCU Firmware integriert.
*   [Mosquitto (⭐33)](https://github.com/homematic-community/ccu-addon-mosquitto) - Mosquitto packaged as Addon for the Homematic CCU3 and OpenCCU
*   [ScriptParser (⭐13)](https://github.com/homematic-community/scriptparser) - Addon zur Syntaxprüfung von HomeMatic Skripten.
*   [WebMatic (⭐27)](https://github.com/ldittmar81/webmatic) - Alternative, für Mobilgeräte optimierte Bedienoberfläche, läuft direkt auf der CCU.
*   [XML-API (⭐128)](https://github.com/homematic-community/XML-API) - Vereinfachter CCU Zugriff via HTTP/XML.

### Interfacing Software

*   [CCU-AI-MCP (⭐3)](https://github.com/mdzio/ccu-ai-mcp) - MCP-Server für OpenCCU/CCU, gibt KI-Assistenten (LLMs) über konfigurierbare HM-Skripte Zugriff auf das Smart Home.
*   [ccu-mcp (⭐8)](https://github.com/claymore666/ccu-mcp) - MCP server enabling AI assistants to control Homematic devices via the CCU's JSON-RPC API, no addon required.
*   [hm2mqtt.js (⭐23)](https://github.com/hobbyquaker/hm2mqtt.js) - Node.js based interface between Homematic and MQTT.
*   [homematicip-hcu (⭐73)](https://github.com/Ediminator/homematicip-hcu) - [Home Assistant](https://www.home-assistant.io/) Integration zur lokalen Anbindung der Homematic IP Home Control Unit (HCU) ohne Cloud.
*   [homematicip\_local (⭐589)](https://github.com/SukramJ/homematicip_local) - [Home Assistant](https://www.home-assistant.io/) Custom Component zur lokalen Anbindung von CCU/OpenCCU (Homematic und Homematic IP), basiert auf aiohomematic.
*   [matterbridge-homematic (⭐4)](https://github.com/hobbyquaker/matterbridge-homematic) - [Matterbridge (⭐965)](https://github.com/Luligu/matterbridge) Plugin to bridge a Homematic CCU's devices to the Matter ecosystem.
*   [OpenCCU-Loom (⭐5)](https://github.com/SukramJ/openccu-loom) - Standalone Go daemon bridging Homematic / Homematic IP CCUs to MQTT (with Home Assistant Discovery), REST + WebSocket, an MCP server and a native Matter bridge.
*   [RedMatic-HomeKit (⭐58)](https://github.com/rdmtc/RedMatic-HomeKit) - HAP-Nodejs basierte Node-RED Nodes um (Homematic-)Geräte in HomeKit einzubinden.
*   [RedMatic-Matter (⭐0)](https://github.com/rdmtc/RedMatic-Matter) - Matter.js basierte Node-RED Nodes, die Homematic-Geräte und beliebige Node-RED-Daten als Matter-Bridge bereitstellen.

### Misc Software

*   [godevccu (⭐1)](https://github.com/SukramJ/godevccu) - Virtual HomeMatic CCU with XML-RPC and JSON-RPC servers written in Go, single static binary for testing integrations.
*   [hm-buildroot (⭐4)](https://github.com/homematic-community/hm-buildroot) - Buildroot environments / cross compiler toolchains to build native applications for the CCU and OpenCCU.
*   [HM-Explorer (⭐8)](https://github.com/thkl/HM-Explorer) - Electron based helper app for the Homematic CCU (macOS/Windows).
*   [HMDeviceFirmware (⭐33)](https://github.com/OpenCCU/HMDeviceFirmware) - Archive of current and past firmware update files for HomeMatic and Homematic IP devices.
*   [hmGetInfo (⭐0)](https://github.com/homematic-community/hmGetInfo) - Collect paramsets and paramsetDescriptions from your Homematic CCU as JSON.
*   [HomeHub (⭐18)](https://github.com/homematic-community/homehub) - PHP/XML-API basiertes Webfrontend. [Forum](https://homematic-forum.de/forum/viewtopic.php?f=41\&t=50538)
*   [Homematic Script Language](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=HeadCrash.hmscript-language-vscode) - Visual Studio Code extension providing syntax highlighting for HomeMatic Script (.hms) files.
*   [pydevccu (⭐9)](https://github.com/SukramJ/pydevccu) - Virtual HomeMatic CCU XML-RPC and JSON-RPC server with fake devices for development and testing.
*   [ReGaHss-Test (⭐3)](https://github.com/OpenCCU/ReGaHss-Test) - Automated System Tests of ReGaHss - the HomeMatic (O)CCU "Logic Layer" (formerly occu-test).

### Software Modules

*   [aiohomematic (⭐167)](https://github.com/SukramJ/aiohomematic) - Python 3 interface to interact with Homematic devices via XML-RPC and JSON-RPC, successor of [pyhomematic (⭐82)](https://github.com/danielperna84/pyhomematic) and base of homematicip\_local.
*   [go-hmccu (⭐5)](https://github.com/mdzio/go-hmccu) - Go library for interfacing the CCU.
*   [Homematic IP Connect API (⭐34)](https://github.com/homematicip/connect-api) - Official WebSocket API and example plugins (Java, Node.js) for developing plugins for the Homematic IP Home Control Unit (HCU).
*   [homematicip-rest-api (⭐239)](https://github.com/hahn-th/homematicip-rest-api) - Python wrapper for the homematicIP REST API (Cloud / Access Point Based).
*   [openccu-loom-client (⭐0)](https://github.com/SukramJ/openccu-loom-client) - Async Python REST + WebSocket client for the OpenCCU-Loom daemon.

### Smart Home Software supporting Homematic

*   [SmartHomeNG](https://www.smarthomeng.de/) - via [Plugins (⭐44)](https://github.com/smarthomeNG/plugins).

  • HB-RF-ETH (⭐58) - Platine und Firmware um ein Homematic Funkmodul (HM-MOD-RPI-PCB, RPI-RF-MOD) per Netzwerk an debmatic oder piVCCU anzubinden.
  • HB-RF-ETH-ng (⭐14) - Modernisierte Next-Generation-Firmware für die HB-RF-ETH Platine mit neuer Weboberfläche und MQTT-Monitoring.
  • HB-UNI-Sen-WEA (⭐69) - Selbstbau-Wetterstation für HomeMatic.

CCU Addons

  • ccu-addon-mui (⭐6) - Moderne, responsive Progressive Web App (PWA) für die CCU3 mit integriertem WebSocket-Server.
  • CUxD (⭐67) - Der "Leatherman" für die CCU. Verbindet FS20, ... (💵 EnOcean, ...), stellt virtuelle Geräte und hilfreiche Tools zur Verfügung.
  • CUxD-Highcharts (⭐16) - Visualisiert CUxD DEVLOGS mit Highcharts/Highstock (verwaist, Maintainer gesucht).
  • Email (⭐47) - HomeMatic CCU Addon für den Email Versand.
  • hm-influxdb2 (⭐1) - Addon for the CCU3/OpenCCU to log data from devices into an InfluxDB2.
  • hm-print (⭐12) - CCU Programme drucken.
  • hm-sonos (⭐17) - HomeMatic CCU Addon zur Steuerung von Sonos Playern.
  • hm_pdetect (⭐73) - Anwesenheitserkennung über die FRITZ!-Box
  • homematic-node-exporter (⭐2) - Prometheus Node Exporter packaged as Addon for the Homematic CCU3 and OpenCCU.
  • HQ-WebUI (⭐50) - Schnelles alternatives WebUI für die Homematic CCU mit Skript-Editor (verwaist, Maintainer gesucht).
  • JP-HB-Devices-addon (⭐57) - Addon das über 80 Selbstbau-Geräte (AskSinPP HomeBrew) in die CCU/OpenCCU Firmware integriert.
  • Mosquitto (⭐33) - Mosquitto packaged as Addon for the Homematic CCU3 and OpenCCU
  • ScriptParser (⭐13) - Addon zur Syntaxprüfung von HomeMatic Skripten.
  • WebMatic (⭐27) - Alternative, für Mobilgeräte optimierte Bedienoberfläche, läuft direkt auf der CCU.
  • XML-API (⭐128) - Vereinfachter CCU Zugriff via HTTP/XML.

Interfacing Software

  • CCU-AI-MCP (⭐3) - MCP-Server für OpenCCU/CCU, gibt KI-Assistenten (LLMs) über konfigurierbare HM-Skripte Zugriff auf das Smart Home.
  • ccu-mcp (⭐8) - MCP server enabling AI assistants to control Homematic devices via the CCU's JSON-RPC API, no addon required.
  • hm2mqtt.js (⭐23) - Node.js based interface between Homematic and MQTT.
  • homematicip-hcu (⭐73) - Home Assistant Integration zur lokalen Anbindung der Homematic IP Home Control Unit (HCU) ohne Cloud.
  • homematicip_local (⭐589) - Home Assistant Custom Component zur lokalen Anbindung von CCU/OpenCCU (Homematic und Homematic IP), basiert auf aiohomematic.
  • matterbridge-homematic (⭐4) - Matterbridge (⭐965) Plugin to bridge a Homematic CCU's devices to the Matter ecosystem.
  • OpenCCU-Loom (⭐5) - Standalone Go daemon bridging Homematic / Homematic IP CCUs to MQTT (with Home Assistant Discovery), REST + WebSocket, an MCP server and a native Matter bridge.
  • RedMatic-HomeKit (⭐58) - HAP-Nodejs basierte Node-RED Nodes um (Homematic-)Geräte in HomeKit einzubinden.
  • RedMatic-Matter (⭐0) - Matter.js basierte Node-RED Nodes, die Homematic-Geräte und beliebige Node-RED-Daten als Matter-Bridge bereitstellen.

Misc Software

  • godevccu (⭐1) - Virtual HomeMatic CCU with XML-RPC and JSON-RPC servers written in Go, single static binary for testing integrations.
  • hm-buildroot (⭐4) - Buildroot environments / cross compiler toolchains to build native applications for the CCU and OpenCCU.
  • HM-Explorer (⭐8) - Electron based helper app for the Homematic CCU (macOS/Windows).
  • HMDeviceFirmware (⭐33) - Archive of current and past firmware update files for HomeMatic and Homematic IP devices.
  • hmGetInfo (⭐0) - Collect paramsets and paramsetDescriptions from your Homematic CCU as JSON.
  • HomeHub (⭐18) - PHP/XML-API basiertes Webfrontend. Forum
  • Homematic Script Language - Visual Studio Code extension providing syntax highlighting for HomeMatic Script (.hms) files.
  • pydevccu (⭐9) - Virtual HomeMatic CCU XML-RPC and JSON-RPC server with fake devices for development and testing.
  • ReGaHss-Test (⭐3) - Automated System Tests of ReGaHss - the HomeMatic (O)CCU "Logic Layer" (formerly occu-test).

Software Modules

  • aiohomematic (⭐167) - Python 3 interface to interact with Homematic devices via XML-RPC and JSON-RPC, successor of pyhomematic (⭐82) and base of homematicip_local.
  • go-hmccu (⭐5) - Go library for interfacing the CCU.
  • Homematic IP Connect API (⭐34) - Official WebSocket API and example plugins (Java, Node.js) for developing plugins for the Homematic IP Home Control Unit (HCU).
  • homematicip-rest-api (⭐239) - Python wrapper for the homematicIP REST API (Cloud / Access Point Based).
  • openccu-loom-client (⭐0) - Async Python REST + WebSocket client for the OpenCCU-Loom daemon.

Smart Home Software supporting Homematic

  • SmartHomeNG - via Plugins (⭐44).

items.title: Awesome Scientific Writing
items.content_text:
### Bibliography

*   [ScholarRef (⭐1)](https://github.com/brodie-neuro/ScholarRef) - Convert citation styles
    (APA 7, Harvard, Vancouver) directly inside Word `.docx` files.

### Converters and Filters

*   [Manubot](https://manubot.org/) - Workflow for writing and publishing scholarly manuscripts with Markdown, persistent-identifier citations, and reproducible builds.
*   [latex2arxiv (⭐5)](https://github.com/YuZh98/latex2arxiv) - Command-line tool which converts
    a LaTeX project into an arXiv-ready ZIP: prunes unused files, strips comments and
    draft markup, and flags arXiv submission blockers before upload.
*   [MyST Markdown CLI](https://mystmd.org/) - Command-line tools for building scientific documents from MyST Markdown with citations, cross-references, and HTML, PDF, and Word output.
*   [Typst (⭐56k)](https://github.com/typst/typst) - Markup-based typesetting system with math, bibliography management, and fast incremental compilation to PDF.

items.title: Awesome Claude Code
items.content_text: ### Agent Orchestration / Obsidian * [claude-intercom (⭐15)](https://github.com/MuhammadTalhaMT/claude-intercom) by [MuhammadTalhaMT](https://github.com/MuhammadTalhaMT) - Relays messages between two Claude Code sessions on separate machines using the Channels API, with delivery tracking and per-message reply budget. Pairs sessions belonging to different accounts, which native cross-session messaging does not. Although this sort of functionality is now a platform feature, it's always cool to see people who have built their own solutions.\
